About
Let’s talk
SMALL TEAMS. SMOOTHER SYSTEMS.
Less manual work.
More forward motion.
Your team has better things to build. I help you automate the busywork, simplify infrastructure, and ship with confidence.
7+ years in production infrastructure — from a 170+ VM environment at Georgia's High Council of Justice to security pipelines at EPAM Systems today.
Let’s simplify your setup
Explore services

WHAT I CAN HELP WITH
Good systems give you room to build.
Practical engineering support for the things that slow your team down. From a single workflow to the infrastructure behind it.
/01
Workflow automation
Make the repetitive automatic.
Connect your tools and turn recurring tasks into dependable workflows. Less copying, clicking, and chasing things down.
Recent example: automated report generation and downloads, then parsed the data and visualized the results to make recurring reporting easier.
Integrations
Custom tooling
Automated operations
/02
CI/CD & delivery
A clearer path to production.
Build pipelines your team can trust, with useful feedback, repeatable releases, and fewer manual steps between commit and deploy.
At JSC Liberty Bank, I overhauled build, deploy, and rollback pipelines across every application — frontend and backend — including apps that had no automation at all before.
Build pipelines
Release automation
GitOps
/03
Code & secrets security
Bring security into the workflow.
Catch vulnerable code, exposed secrets, and risky dependencies earlier. Put practical security checks where your developers already work.
Currently working hands-on with GitHub Advanced Security, CodeQL, and Mend.io in production at EPAM Systems.
GitHub Advanced Security
Secret management
/04
Cloud & infrastructure
Infrastructure you can reason about.
Simplify your environments, find wasted resources, and move manual configuration into versioned, repeatable infrastructure as code.
Managed and supported 170+ Windows and Linux virtual machines at Georgia's High Council of Justice, and run a full Proxmox/Kubernetes/Ansible homelab in my own time.
Infrastructure as code
Cloud & on-prem
Containers

Clear steps. Shared understanding.
You work directly with me, from the first conversation to the final handover.

Agree on a practical scope, clear priorities, and what a good result looks like.

Build & improve

Hand it over
Leave you with documented systems and the knowledge to keep them running.

Slick - DevOps & automation for small software teams
Skip to content
slick
.
Services
Approach
Toolkit
About
Let’s talk
SMALL TEAMS. SMOOTHER SYSTEMS.
Less manual work.
More forward motion.
Your team has better things to build. I help you automate the busywork, simplify infrastructure, and ship with confidence.
7+ years in production infrastructure — from a 170+ VM environment at Georgia's High Council of Justice to security pipelines at EPAM Systems today.
Let’s simplify your setup
Explore services
↓
Aleksandre Ghvineria
/
Independent DevOps consultant
Less friction.
More flow.
01 / SOURCE
Commit
02 / VALIDATE
Check
03 / PACKAGE
Build
04 / RELEASE
Deploy
DESIGNED TO WORK TOGETHER
/ 05 OBSERVE
LESS FRICTION, FROM END TO END
Automation
·
CI/CD
·
Security
·
Infrastructure
WHAT I CAN HELP WITH
Good systems give you room to build.
Practical engineering support for the things that slow your team down. From a single workflow to the infrastructure behind it.
/01
Workflow automation
Make the repetitive automatic.
Connect your tools and turn recurring tasks into dependable workflows. Less copying, clicking, and chasing things down.
Recent example: automated report generation and downloads, then parsed the data and visualized the results to make recurring reporting easier.
Integrations
Custom tooling
Automated operations
/02
CI/CD & delivery
A clearer path to production.
Build pipelines your team can trust, with useful feedback, repeatable releases, and fewer manual steps between commit and deploy.
At JSC Liberty Bank, I overhauled build, deploy, and rollback pipelines across every application — frontend and backend — including apps that had no automation at all before.
Build pipelines
Release automation
GitOps
/03
Code & secrets security
Bring security into the workflow.
Catch vulnerable code, exposed secrets, and risky dependencies earlier. Put practical security checks where your developers already work.
Currently working hands-on with GitHub Advanced Security, CodeQL, and Mend.io in production at EPAM Systems.
GitHub Advanced Security
Secret management
/04
Cloud & infrastructure
Infrastructure you can reason about.
Simplify your environments, find wasted resources, and move manual configuration into versioned, repeatable infrastructure as code.
Managed and supported 170+ Windows and Linux virtual machines at Georgia's High Council of Justice, and run a full Proxmox/Kubernetes/Ansible homelab in my own time.
Infrastructure as code
Cloud & on-prem
Containers
HOW WE GET THERE
Clear steps. Shared understanding.
You work directly with me, from the first conversation to the final handover.
01
Understand
We start with your team, your setup, and what is getting in the way.
02
Make a plan
Agree on a practical scope, clear priorities, and what a good result looks like.
03
Build & improve
Implement in manageable steps, with testing and visibility along the way.
04
Hand it over
Leave you with documented systems and the knowledge to keep them running.
THE TOOLKIT
Your stack. A practical approach.
Cloud, on-prem, or somewhere in between. I work with the tools that fit your team and the systems you already have.
